newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady despite improved demand.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady despite improved demand.

text.p: Enquiries in the Singapore bunker market improved slightly on Tuesday but suppliers were cautious in raising their offers, traders said.

Most traders did not expect significant movements in the bunker market later amid little change in the fuel oil cargo market and crude values. "Demand is still not significant and some suppliers need to move their cargoes," said one trader. "It's hard for prices to go up."

The 380-cst was quoted at $96/$100 per tonne and the 180-cst at $103/$106. MDO and gas oil were quoted slightly lower than their previous levels at around $190 and $200 respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (65 8703571)
